note: One entry per operator. `roles` binds each execution role to a profile id in agents.json. `requires` lists the runtime grants the operator's execute.md actually uses; the validator rejects a role whose profile does not permit them. `policy` answers the three standing questions for every operator: does it search the web when no reference exists in the tree, is it bound to published Grammar, does it generate images.

workspace.bind.why: Route resolution reads canonical files and a runtime registry; nothing here is a judgement call.

business.decide.why: An unfamiliar business or pricing model may need bounded reference research before the coverage matrix can be frozen; the critique is a separate fresh execution.

architecture.decide.why: Alternatives and compatibility need evidence beyond the repository; the operator's schema already pins the decision model.

backend.implement.why: Writes product source inside a frozen mutation contract; it follows patterns/be and never invents business behaviour.

fe.direction.decide.why: Bounded research runs only when the domain or interaction model is unfamiliar and the tree holds no reference. The direction renders an inspectable page, not a picture; product artwork is generated only when product authority names it.

fe.presentation.resolve.why: A lookup against a closed rule inventory. Nothing may be searched for, because a value the knowledge does not publish is RULE_MISSING, not a research task.

fe.source.apply.why: Writes only classes the resolution receipt already contains, following patterns/fe. It decides nothing.

fe.surface.audit.why: Capture is mechanical; judgement is a fresh reviewer that sees rasters and claims only. A claim is never evidence of passing.

quality.verify.why: Runs declared gates and reports measured results; it repairs nothing.

uat.verify.why: Drives a real journey with an auto-provisioned learner and never asks a person to sign in; the verdict comes from a fresh reviewer per lane.

release.deploy.why: Immutable release under declared authorization with recovery and rollback in the same pass.

platform.operate.why: Shared observability, Sonar, or tunnel work from exact evidence; never product deployment.

content.generate.why: The teacher brief may research the topic; production writes, codes, and generates images to a stated claim; the critique is independent of the producer. The operator's schema pins both models.

git.publish.why: Non-force publication of an approved boundary; the schema forbids every destructive operation.
